title: Cash Recovery Share for Multi-Year Northgate+ Annual Members
content:
Under the annual cancellation schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, how much of the member-bonus Northgate Cash the Cash recovery takes depends on the number of settled annual fees the Northgate+ Annual membership carries, counting every settled annual fee charge on the membership record, the current one included.

| Settled annual fees on the membership | Share of the member-bonus Cash the Cash recovery takes |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0 (none of it) |
| exactly 2 | 0.5 (half of it) |
| fewer than 2 | not reduced by this rule |

The member-bonus Cash is the net Northgate Cash of the twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date (the Cash earned less the Cash reversed in that period) less the Cash the tier's earn rate yields on the net basis of that period, never below zero; the Cash recovery that takes the stated share is rounded half up to the cent after the share is applied.

**Hypothetical illustration.** With member-bonus Cash of 4.30: a membership carrying 3 settled annual fees has no Cash recovery; one carrying exactly 2 has a Cash recovery of 2.15.
